cases.question: Số sinh viên theo kết quả cuối học phần
variants: so sinh vien theo ket qua
Mỗi loại kết quả có bao nhiêu sinh viên
expected_sql: SELECT final_result, COUNT(*) AS students FROM oulad GROUP BY final_result
SELECT final_result, COUNT(DISTINCT id_student) AS students FROM oulad GROUP BY final_result
cases.author: nlminuong

cases.question: Tỷ lệ bỏ học theo môn học
variants: ty le bo hoc tung mon
Môn nào sinh viên bỏ học nhiều, tính theo tỷ lệ
expected_sql: SELECT code_module, AVG(CASE WHEN final_result = 'Withdrawn' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS rate FROM oulad GROUP BY code_module
SELECT code_module, 100 * AVG(CASE WHEN final_result = 'Withdrawn' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS rate_percent FROM oulad GROUP BY code_module
cases.author: nlminuong

cases.question: Tỷ lệ đạt theo trình độ học vấn

expected_sql: SELECT highest_education, AVG(CASE WHEN final_result IN ('Pass', 'Distinction') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS rate FROM oulad GROUP BY highest_education
SELECT highest_education, 100 * AVG(CASE WHEN final_result IN ('Pass', 'Distinction') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS rate_percent FROM oulad GROUP BY highest_education
cases.author: nlminuong

cases.question: Số sinh viên của mỗi môn kỳ 2014J so với kỳ 2013J
variants: so sinh vien moi mon ky 2014J so voi 2013J
expected_sql: SELECT code_module, COUNT(CASE WHEN code_presentation = '2013J' THEN 1 END) AS students_2013j, COUNT(CASE WHEN code_presentation = '2014J' THEN 1 END) AS students_2014j FROM oulad WHERE code_presentation IN ('2013J', '2014J') GROUP BY code_module

SELECT code_module, COUNT(CASE WHEN code_presentation = '2014J' THEN 1 END) AS students_2014j, COUNT(CASE WHEN code_presentation = '2013J' THEN 1 END) AS students_2013j FROM oulad WHERE code_presentation IN ('2013J', '2014J') GROUP BY code_module
cases.author: nlminuong

cases.question: 3 vùng có tỷ lệ bỏ học cao nhất trong từng môn
variants: top 3 vung bo hoc nhieu nhat moi mon
expected_sql: SELECT code_module, region, rate FROM (SELECT code_module, region, AVG(CASE WHEN final_result = 'Withdrawn' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY code_module ORDER BY AVG(CASE WHEN final_result = 'Withdrawn' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) DESC) AS k FROM oulad GROUP BY code_module, region) AS ranked WHERE k <= 3

SELECT code_module, region, rate_percent FROM (SELECT code_module, region, 100 * AVG(CASE WHEN final_result = 'Withdrawn' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS rate_percent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY code_module ORDER BY AVG(CASE WHEN final_result = 'Withdrawn' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) DESC) AS k FROM oulad GROUP BY code_module, region) AS ranked WHERE k <= 3
cases.author: nlminuong
